name: php-companion
description: Stable, on-demand PhpStorm-inspired PHP project workflows for Visual Studio Code.

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @php-companion/runtime-probe build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/language-spec build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/phpdoc build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/parser build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/project build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/index build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/type-system build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/interop build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/semantic-provider build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/semantic-provider-host build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/framework-symfony build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/framework-doctrine build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/semantic build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/refactor build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/language-server build && pnpm --filter @php-companion/testkit build
scripts.lint: eslint src test packages scripts esbuild.mjs vitest.config.ts vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.test:packages: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter @php-companion/runtime-probe test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/language-spec test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/phpdoc test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/parser test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/project test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/index test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/type-system test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/interop test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/semantic-provider test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/semantic-provider-host test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/framework-symfony test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/framework-doctrine test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/semantic test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/refactor test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/language-server test && pnpm --filter @php-companion/testkit test
scripts.test:extension:packaged: pnpm package && tsc -p test/extension/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-extension-test.mjs ./dist-test/runPackagedTest.js
scripts.test:extension:open-source-profile: pnpm package && tsc -p test/extension/tsconfig.json && node scripts/run-extension-test.mjs ./dist-test/runPackagedTest.js
scripts.package:all: pnpm package && pnpm package:open-source-pack && pnpm package:recommended-pack
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm package:all && pnpm verify:vsix

phpCompanion.disabledExtensions.description: PHP extensions known to be unavailable for this workspace. Composer config.platform entries set to false are also honored.

phpCompanion.phpExecutablePath.description: Optional PHP executable used for version detection.

phpCompanion.languageServer.enabled.description: Enable the self-hosted PHP language server with precise diagnostics, type-aware completion, hover, signatures, navigation, references and safe refactoring. When this setting has no explicit value, PHP Companion stays disabled if Intelephense is installed.

phpCompanion.semanticProviders.description: Trusted semantic provider executables to run in isolated one-shot processes. Providers are never discovered from project files; process isolation limits failures but is not a security sandbox.

phpCompanion.diagnostics.disabledCodes.description: Diagnostic codes that the self-hosted PHP language server must not publish. Configuration changes apply to open PHP documents immediately.

phpCompanion.diagnostics.severity.description: Severity overrides keyed by stable diagnostic code. Use off to suppress a code.

phpCompanion.indexing.mode.description: Controls project indexing. Indexing is never performed during activation.

phpCompanion.indexing.onStartup.deprecationMessage: Use phpCompanion.indexing.mode. Startup indexing is no longer supported.

phpCompanion.imports.optimize.preview.description: Show a Preview/Apply flow before optimizing imports.

phpCompanion.imports.sort.description: Sort imports by kind then FQN, or by FQN only.

phpCompanion.experimental.refactoring.description: Enable experimental project-wide indexing and refactoring.

phpCompanion.move.enabled.description: Update namespaces and semantic references when PHP files are moved within Composer PSR-4 paths.

phpCompanion.move.preview.description: Preview namespace and proven reference changes before the Safe Move command applies one undoable workspace edit.

phpCompanion.rename.enabled.description: Provide stable F2 Rename for PHP class-like declarations. Disable this when another PHP extension should own Rename.

phpCompanion.rename.file.description: Controls renaming a matching PSR-4 PHP file. Use Shift+Enter in the Rename input to inspect the ordered file and text edits in VS Code's standard preview.

phpCompanion.rename.phpDoc.description: Update semantic PHPDoc type references during Rename.

phpCompanion.rename.stringReferences.description: Reserved for future string-reference support. PHP Companion 0.3 never changes ordinary strings.
